name: DB Optimize
description: Optimize, analyze, check, repair and back up database tables from an admin UI, cron or Drush.
project_description: DB Optimize is a lightweight utility module that helps Drupal site administrators keep their MySQL/MariaDB database tables healthy. It exposes the four MySQL maintenance statements — OPTIMIZE TABLE, ANALYZE TABLE, CHECK TABLE and REPAIR TABLE — through an admin interface, scheduled cron jobs (run directly or via queue workers), and a set of Drush commands. It also offers a database overview page that groups table sizes by content type and lists the largest tables, and a mysqldump-based full-database backup download. Each operation can be limited to specific tables or applied to all tables. Cron scheduling is per-operation with configurable frequency, and per-operation run/duration/error metrics are stored in state. Compatible with MySQL and MariaDB; PostgreSQL is not supported.
